nodes.name: Stamp Reply on Opportunity
nodes.notes:
Writes the buyer's own words onto the OPPORTUNITY so they show in the Buyer Interest list view. GHL notes are a one-to-many collection and can never be a column; a custom field can.

Runs on EVERY actionable reply, not just the ones that send - an objection is the most useful thing to see at a glance. Continues on error because a buyer with no opportunity is a 404 here and that must not fail the reply.

'"' + t + '" - ' + tag : t; })() }] }) }}
